notes: As an adjective, 'больной' describes a person who is sick or a part of the body that hurts.
When used as a noun, 'больной' means 'patient' in a hospital or clinic setting.
Do not confuse this with 'болеть', which is the verb 'to be ill' or 'to ache'.

senses.definition: Suffering from an illness; not in good health.
